# `oaap app visibility`

who sees an instance: everybody, or only some groups (RFC-0007).

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap app visibility [--tenant INSTANCE_TENANT]
                           name {all,groups} [groups]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `name` | -- |
| `mode` | (one of `all`, `groups`) |
| `groups` | comma-separated group tags, e.g. buero,finanzen (with 'groups') |
| `--tenant INSTANCE_TENANT` | tenant label: read the instance as a NAME inside this tenant (also: <tenant>/<name>) |
